title: ranunculus flabellatus var. nidulans
intro: Ranunculus flabellatus var. nidulans, commonly known as the Yellow Alpine Buttercup, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and pain relief, due to its reported health benefits of reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus flabellatus var. nidulans are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which are believed to be caused by the bioactive constituents present in the plant, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of the plant for medicinal use.
